answer: The sable schedule is applied in quill and yarrow makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3902 identities would post 4893 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
